desc: Co-op: player 2's X starts Yoshi's ride and player 2's X again ends it (before, only player 1's X could); then player 2 swaps to the next partner with R and walks and hops the new one (before, a swapped-in partner stood waiting and player 2 could neither walk nor hop it). Rogueport's plaza, Mario put at 240 0 20. Shot: after (the swapped-in partner, standing)
log_must: player 2's X goes to the partner's field move under way
